name: codex-plugin
description: Xicode AI plugins for testing, configuration documentation, knowledge maintenance, business PRDs and knowledge-base Markdown.

plugins.name: apifox-api-testing
plugins.description: Design and execute PRD-driven full-scenario API tests through Apifox MCP and dbhub MCP.

plugins.name: flowx-config-docs
plugins.description: Query FlowX dictionaries, menu permissions, and internationalization through dbhub and render fixed multilingual Markdown documentation.

plugins.name: source-business-prd
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer evidence-backed business knowledge and as-is PRDs across source repositories with optional database observations.

plugins.name: source-business-knowledge
plugins.description: Generate structured, business-only Markdown knowledge from source repositories, with technical evidence kept separately.

plugins.name: obsidian-kb-maintenance
plugins.description: Maintain Obsidian note properties, Dataview directory indexes, evidence-backed Wiki pages and daily reading guides through the official CLI.

plugins.name: outline-obsidian-sync
plugins.description: Mirror an Outline knowledge base into Obsidian incrementally with local attachments, then run existing knowledge maintenance.
